title: Create 2 tasks

task.title: Reproduce and localize orphan function_call_output after Claude-to-Codex model switch
task.description: Reproduce the verified persisted-session incident where a healthy claude-bridge assistant toolCall and matching aborted/error toolResult were present in raw Pi history, but the subsequent OpenAI Codex request was rejected with `No tool call found for function call output with call_id toolu_01PLWRr5aidacJz7F8PQzYzg.` The clean four-message `convertResponsesMessages` path preserves the pair, so diagnosis must reconstruct the actual effective request pipeline and delta-debug the surrounding session state before selecting a fix layer. Determine whether loss occurs in SessionManager/buildSessionContext, extension context hooks, transformMessages, OpenAI Responses conversion, Codex request continuation/state, or remote validation. Do not patch around the symptom before the first divergent representation is proven.

requiredReferences.reason: Cross-provider thinking/tool-ID transformation and tool-span synthesis/skip behavior.
Canonical session context reconstruction and compaction/branch boundary.
Additional buildSessionContext implementation/surface; determine whether it participates in this runtime path.

suggestedReferences.reason: Existing foreign tool-call ID coverage and gap comparison.

sourceRefs.reason: Verified incident: healthy e:e965448f toolUse, matching e:0eb3965f error result, and repeated Codex errors e:634d2079/e:da744c84/e:adcc688e.

acceptanceCriteria: A descriptor-safe synthetic fixture reconstructs the consequential message/control sequence without reading the personal source session during normal test execution.

The investigation records the exact message/item inventory at each boundary: persisted active branch, buildSessionContext result, post-context-hook messages, transformMessages result, Responses input items, and any continuation/state metadata supplied to Codex.

Delta-debugging identifies the first boundary where the matching toolCall disappears, changes identity, is invalidated, or becomes unrecognized while its toolResult remains; if every local boundary preserves the pair, the task records bounded evidence for a remote Codex validation/state hypothesis rather than claiming a local projection bug.
The existing clean-path case remains explicit: a foreign Opus toolUse plus matching isError toolResult converts to paired function_call/function_call_output items with identical call_id.

The investigation separately records the three relevant artifact classes without conflation: real tool-span orphaning, empty error assistant shells from failed retries, and the legacy Bridge zero-block normal-stop shell.
No live paid-provider request is required. Any optional real-provider confirmation is separately bounded and explicitly authorized by Patrik before execution.
The task ends with an evidence-backed owner/fix recommendation and a minimal deterministic regression target for T003; no speculative production fix is committed.

validation.description: Run the focused offline reproduction/delta-debug fixture and retain body-free item-type/call-id evidence.

notes: Before implementation, assign a dedicated topic worktree/branch per AGENTS.FORK.md; do not execute this task directly in stable main or pg/daily.
Likely upstream-capable platform correctness issue. Choose pg/core from main only after diagnosis shows the bug exists on upstream parity; otherwise use pg/ext from pg/daily.

task.title: Enforce atomic tool-call/result spans across transformed provider history
task.description: After T002 identifies the responsible boundary, harden Pi's canonical/cross-provider message transformation so a provider request never contains a tool/function result without its matching call and never contains duplicate synthetic plus real results for the same call. Preserve genuine error tool results, exact call/result identity, chronology, and provider-specific replay constraints. Prefer a single canonical coherent-span invariant over provider-specific symptom repair.

requiredReferences.reason: Current second-pass skip/synthetic-result logic and tool ID transformation owner.
OpenAI Responses pairing contract and request item conversion.

sourceRefs.reason: Verified cross-provider incident and repeated orphan function_call_output failures.

acceptanceCriteria: Every emitted toolResult/function_call_output has exactly one earlier matching toolCall/function_call under the target provider's identity rules, or the whole unsafe span/request is refused before network mutation with a typed actionable error.
Skipping an error/aborted assistant cannot leave its tool results in output; preserving a real result cannot drop its call.
A user interruption that triggers a synthetic `No result provided` cannot later produce duplicate synthetic and real results for the same call ID; deterministic precedence is documented and tested.
Foreign provider tool-call IDs remain pair-preserving after normalization, including IDs with and without OpenAI Responses item-id suffixes.
Genuine error results such as `Command aborted` remain error results and are not rewritten into successful or fabricated content.
Tests cover assistant error/aborted with toolCall, real result before/after user boundary, duplicate result, missing call, multiple parallel calls, model switch, and the exact T002 regression.
Foreign-thinking handling is not silently changed as a side effect; any policy change to textification/exclusion requires a separate accepted decision.

The implementation is developed in the correct dedicated pg/core or pg/ext worktree chosen from T002 evidence, passes targeted packages/ai tests and npm run check, and updates the applicable changelog/docs.
